modules.name: frontend
modules.notes: Next.js 16 App Router application.

modules.name: frontend/app
modules.notes: App Router entry; segmented by feature routes.

modules.name: frontend/app/admin
modules.notes: Admin routes and admin-only UI.

modules.name: frontend/app/dashboard
modules.notes: User dashboard routes. Student routes: /dashboard, /dashboard/activities, /dashboard/attendance, /dashboard/labs, /dashboard/labs/[id], /dashboard/settings.

modules.name: frontend/app/dashboard/attendance
modules.notes: Student attendance module. Modular structure: hooks, types, calendar/stats components. Features: safe date handling, retry logic.

modules.name: frontend/components/feedback
modules.notes: Feedback system. Modular structure: schema, hooks, form/submit/preview components. Includes FeedbackDialog with centralized API use.

modules.name: frontend/app/report
modules.notes: Reports routes (incl. dynamic segments). Student/public routes: /report/[code], /report/[code]/student/[studentId].

modules.name: frontend/app/lectures
modules.notes: Lectures routes and lecture-related UI.

modules.name: frontend/app/auth
modules.notes: Authentication routes.

modules.name: frontend/app/labs
modules.notes: Labs routes.

modules.name: frontend/app/editor-00
modules.notes: Editor prototype/feature route segment.

modules.name: frontend/components/ui
modules.notes: Shared UI components (includes a large sidebar module).

modules.name: frontend/hooks
modules.notes: Shared React hooks.

modules.name: frontend/lib/api
modules.notes: REST/OpenAPI API clients and domain-specific API wrappers.

modules.name: frontend/lib/logger
modules.notes: Centralized frontend logger implementation (currently unused across frontend/src).

modules.name: frontend/app/admin/attestation
modules.notes: Admin attestation management. Includes scores table, student details, and attendance statistics components.

modules.name: backend/services/attestation
modules.notes: Core attestation logic. Includes attendance_calculator.py (score formula, transfer merges) and helpers.py.

modules.name: backend/services/transfer
modules.notes: Handles student transfers and attendance snapshot merging.

modules.name: backend/api/student
modules.notes: Student-facing API endpoints, including attendance and score reporting.

modules.name: backend
modules.notes: Backend service exists in repo; frontend proxies requests to BACKEND_URL.

modules.name: deploy
modules.notes: Docker/nginx/systemd scripts and environment templates.

modules.name: docs
modules.notes: Operational guides (server hardening, bot setup).

modules.name: process-docs
modules.notes: Process and spec documentation (audits, specs, steering).
